audit.whatIsWrong: This side gave Ornn levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items while the prose said level 2 is yours ('his weak lane damage lets you shove and chunk him freely') and first item is yours. Chart and prose disagreed on four rows, and the mirror (ornn__yone) has already been realigned to Yone / Skill / Skill / Ornn at rows 1-4.
audit.why: Ornn's lane damage is low and his answer is a 7-9s pillar, so a Yone with Spirit Cleave up wins level 2 and the first-item window; level 6 is Ornn's because Call of the Forge God engages from 2500 range and applies Brittle. 54.14% supports Yone holding the later rows.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Skill / Yone / Skill / Skill / Ornn / Yone / Yone as one atomic paired group, matching the mirror rows and the packet, with ratings and the contradicting why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and phase referenced Volcanic Rupture, Bellows Breath and Call of the Forge God with no cooldowns, so none of the 'trade when it is down' lines were actionable.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 7-9s, Bellows Breath 10-12s and Call of the Forge God 100-140s — three very different clocks that the player has to hold separately.
audit.corrected: 7-9s put on the pillar in dosFull[0].d and phases[1].why, 10-12s on Bellows Breath in dosFull[2].d and phases[5].why, and the 2500-range engage into phases[4].why and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two content fields said to 'Windwall' Call of the Forge God. Yone has no Wind Wall. Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar was described only as 'wall-knockup setup' — the pillar is terrain, so it can block Mortal Steel's third-cast dash, which is the interaction that actually decides this lane. Fate Sealed was again called a knockup setter; it is a blink behind the last champion in a line plus a pull. The R was described as a 'double-knockup with a second cast' without saying the recast is Ornn charging into the elemental to redirect it.
audit.why: Riot ability text in the brief; the mirror recorded the same pillar-versus-dash finding.
audit.corrected: Windwall removed for sidestepping; the pillar stated as terrain that can deny your Q3 dash; Brittle tied to what makes his E knockup lethal; Fate Sealed restated as blink-and-pull; the R recast described as Ornn charging into the elemental to redirect it.

edits.before: At 6 it's even — his Call of the Forge God engage is dodgeable but threatens a heavy trade.
edits.after: At 6 he leads — Call of the Forge God engages from 2500 range and leaves you Brittle.

edits.before: Late is even at best — a scaled Ornn's brittle chains and upgraded items interrupt your window and enable his team.
edits.after: Late is yours in the sidelane — his brittle chains matter in a teamfight, but his low solo DPS still loses the 1v1.

edits.before: W shield-grit covers every exchange you start. Only take the trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields the exchange and his base damage is low — step up whenever Volcanic Rupture's 9s is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online for both: his pillar into a Brittle Bellows Breath answers your pattern. Trade only after the pillar is spent.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind him and pulls, it is not a knockup. Call of the Forge God engages from 2500 range and makes you Brittle.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Volcanic Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force the fight the moment it completes, while Bellows Breath is on its 10-12s.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Ornn carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind their back line and pulls it to you — build your teamfight around that. Ornn carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture's pillar is terrain — it can block your Q3 dash. 7-9s.

edits.before: Ornn wastes Volcanic Rupture — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bellows Breath applies Brittle on 10-12s — trade after it whiffs.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Brittle from Bellows Breath is what turns his E knockup lethal.

edits.before: Track Ornn's Volcanic Rupture: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. When it is down — Q3-R him.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture leaves a pillar — terrain that can stop your Q3 dash and set up his E knockup.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God (R) is a long-range engage that can double-knockup with a second cast; you can E out of the first hit or Windwall the recast, and your all-in damage post-6 outpaces his tanky low-DPS kit.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God (R) travels 2500 units and he recasts to charge into it, redirecting the elemental for a second knockup; sidestep the line instead of standing in it, and your post-6 all-in outpaces his low-DPS kit.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 sit in skill-check territory: Ornn's brittle CC punishes mistakes, but his low DPS means you win any clean trade when his cooldowns are down. At 6 you can dodge or Windwall his Call of the Forge God, and your first-item power gives you a real kill window.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 sit in skill-check territory: Ornn's Brittle CC punishes mistakes, but his low DPS means you win any clean trade when his cooldowns are down. At 6 sidestep Call of the Forge God — you have no windwall for it — and your first-item power gives you a real kill window.

notes: Fourth Windwall error in this slice: the content layer told a Yone player to Windwall Ornn's ultimate.
